opening: The muscles of my back, upper arms and thighs have become stiff.
Those same muscles have been wasting away.
The stiffness and wasting started about six years ago.
Walking is getting harder; I can only take short steps.
It's getting harder to get up from lying on my back.
It's getting harder to bend in any direction.
Six years ago I started injecting myself with pentazocine, 60 mg a day into my muscles.
I injected promethazine together with it.
I was dependent on alcohol for 13 years.

opening.text: The muscles in my back, upper arms, and thighs have become stiff and are wasting away. This started about six years ago. Walking is getting harder since I can only take short steps, and it's getting harder to get up from lying on my back or bend in any direction. Six years ago, I started injecting myself with pentazocine, 60 mg a day, into my muscles, and I injected promethazine together with it. I was also dependent on alcohol for 13 years.
